question: A straight conductor is moving in a uniform magnetic field. Under which of the following conditions will the induced motional EMF be zero?

options.A: When the rod moves perpendicular to the magnetic field.
options.B: When the rod moves at an angle of $45^\circ$ to the magnetic field.
options.C: When the velocity vector is parallel to the magnetic field lines.
options.D: When the rod has a finite resistance.
